name: user-walkthrough
description: The Playwright leg of the quality tripod: drive the running app like a real user to prove a feature works in the browser. Enumerate every workflow the feature touches, walk each end-to-end with assertions and screenshots, then run the edge-case battery (empty states, invalid input, double-actions, refresh mid-flow, rapid navigation, small viewport, back button). Findings and unexercised cells go to the ledger; reruns after fixes until green. Green unit tests are not this.
